Subscriptions usually provide commercial free programming.

Closed captions are unacceptable. As a senior citizen, this is critical. What am I paying for.?
I actually feel taken advantage of. I committed to paying $79.99 a year in addition to my You Tube subscription. No refunds? Poor business practice.

Finally, I was able to get through 2 hours of programming, with lots of buffering and freeze problems (no other live programming on my TV has this issue) I got irreconcilable “content errors” and has to once again uninstall and reinstall. Someone needs to get at their bugs. This is crazy.

reviews.title: Frustrating, poorly executed and insufficient.
reviews.text: The app is hard to navigate and the formating is terrible. It has no memory, so whenever it decides to throw you off you have to start from the beginning, doing all the steps to get to the place you were all over again. It’s really hard to move through episodes with the time bar, which makes it so much worse. It also doesn’t have a forward and back button so unless you have perfect aim and saintly patience, for your sanity just forget the thing you missed. It doesn’t even have the ability to tell if you’ve watched or listened to a show already. The on demand shows don’t appear until late or the next day, which is infuriating because that is the only thing I wanted in a subscription. I want to watch one after I finish scripted TV for the day, like I used to when I had a DVR. Live is okay but all the ads are golf related and you can’t rewind even if you have the patience. At least there’s fewer steps when it boots you, but also no way to get the content you missed until the on demand version appears and no one cares that much.

reviews.title: The Wrong Move
reviews.text: It’s so unfortunate that MS-NOW has moved its platform to a subscription model. In a time when getting information out  - especially in an election year - is absolutely critical to have voters get “the other side” from the Right Wing Echo Chamber and the flood of lies and deception from the White House, MS-NOW needs to stand in the breech to be the light in the darkness for all, not just those who subscribe. I hope they go back to their “old model” for the daily stories and opinions, and offer a different level of service for those who want access to the hosts and features currently being offered. This is coming from a longtime loyal and current viewer, so it’s not just a passing thought. Keep shining the light in these dark times.

The change and charge to now access the news and commentary by your  experienced and talented correspondents is disheartening and elitist.  
I use to listen to your regular programming in my car,  late at night or when unable to watch live programming but now one must subscribe with a hefty fee! (1/2 of what it cost me to fill my gas tank btw!!)
With the important election coming up you are shutting out those unable to pay for the intelligent perspectives your correspondents and writers present. I thought fair, intelligent news presentation was your business but in reality it’s about lining your pockets on the backs of your users.   Press is no longer free with MSNow.

reviews.title: Least intuitive app ever
reviews.text: The playback on this app is horrible. Beside the fact that you can’t login without a cable subscription on the Roku app, the show playback doesn’t hold your place if you pause it or reflect that you’ve already watched an episode. The screen is so touchy that you can’t do anything else on the app while a show is playing (scroll for other episodes or check the news) - if you do, you have to start the show over. Once I finish a show, why would it immediately start playing the previous day’s episode?  If it were at all intuitive, it would play the show from the following day or if you’re watching the most recent episode, either stop altogether or play the latest episode from another show.  Hopefully it will be updated soon.

reviews.title: Too many ads, doesn’t work on iOS 27
reviews.text: On iOS 26/ 15 pro, the app has too many ads, but worked seamlessly to AirPlay to Apple tv, so I was okay with that workaround. I’ve upgraded to 18 pro/ios 27, and now the app force quits when I try to update it. The membership does not have third-party login on Apple TV, which is not disclosed when signing up. Still many bugs to work out before the service is viable and useful. I’m not interested in streaming on my laptop, and have already cancelled my subscription. Too many issues to recommend to phone users, and way too many ads on live tv when you successfully connect. Frankly, it is deceptive marketing to bury the lack of tv app log in function in the website faq instead of the billing page. Shady, I expected better from ms now. The content is good; but this app is not ready for launch.

reviews.title: I expected more from this app.

I wound up getting charged for a full year as I was intending to purchase for the advertised 8.99 a month to try the app. I prefer using my tune in app that does not make me hear more commercials than actual news. Also create an app that does not kick you off if you have to read a text message on your phone. This is the only News channel I trust anymore. If you want people to get real news stop charging  people the rates you do and make the app more user friendly. I will not renew. It's easier to just listen to tune in where I don't get kicked off if I need to do another activity on my phone.

reviews.title: It’ll do I guess
reviews.text: Glad to finally have access to MSNow without Cable. However, this app leaves a lot to be desired. It is buggy and poorly written. It doesn’t hold my place in videos I’ve watched, hold history of played items. And crashes when I navigate away from the app, requiring the opened content to be closed completely and re-opened. You then have to fiddle with it to find your place, because as mentioned it is not saved.  Please give this app back to the developer that built it, and have them rewrite it, as to  make it worthy of the content you are serving. As you are doing your Anchors, production Teams, and writing staff a complete disservice by offering their content in such a malformed application platform. A side note, Make this available on Apple TV as well!!

reviews.title: What A Bad Start On Apple TV👎🏼
reviews.text:
For people who are not with cable (or cable like streaming packages), and have Apple TV, this is not worth the membership price even at $40 for the first year. Sure, you can mirror to your TV if you have another Apple device but not everybody does.

So if you do have all the right equipment you can watch live TV via mirroring but most people prefer up to date videos that they can access on their schedule. And let’s face it, the great majority are following lead commentators. Then there is the issue of shows having day old news which is stale news especially when there are so many other options for current information. Heck MS Now podcasts broadcast their shows within hours. Why pay for something that is inferior to that?

I don’t know what hurdles exist to providing video content in a timely manner, but I am pretty sure Versant is not going to be able to sell future memberships as this stands right now via Apple TV

People who have standalone streaming services for news rely on companies to provide daily content because they have no recording options. It’s a no brainer in today’s world to have that coverage delivered quickly. With standard television services losing customers to streaming, one would assume this would be top priority.

reviews.title: Annual Membership is Deceptive
reviews.text: Nowhere does it say that the annual membership does not enable live viewing on the AppleTV app. Only after you sign up for the membership do you realize that you can only use AppleTV with a subscription with a conventional television service. You can only watch live on iPhone or iPad with the membership. I don’t want to watch the news on my phone so I spent needlessly on a one year membership I will not use. FYI the CNN AppleTV app is FULLY FUNCTIONAL with their annual membership. This limitation should be CLEARLY DISCLOSED when subscribing to a membership. In the year 2026 this should not be an issue there are many many streaming apps for live tv with a subscription separate from a cable provider.

reviews.title: Greed wins again
reviews.text: So, now you want money, email addresses and any other data you can get by forcing users to create an account.  We have to sign up and pay for something that consistently gets worse with every iteration.  Your help link says it’s possible to sign in with a TV provider, watch the live stream and avoid creating an account by using a browser. That’s a lie. You can only watch 10 mins of it then you’re  still directed to create an account. I used to think that MSNBC/MS NOW was above money grabbing and paywall restrictions. Boy was I wrong.  Surely you’ll lose viewers because of this. And it wouldn’t be surprising if your ratings took a hit too.  Whoever’s dumb idea it was to jump on the subscription bandwagon should be pounding sand right now.

reviews.title: Doesn’t support Landscape mode
reviews.text: I use my iPad exclusively when checking news and social media. It has a magnetically attached keypad, so there is never a time when I’m not looking at it in Landscape mode. The MS Now app came up sideways when I first loaded it, which doesn’t work for me. I thought maybe the programmers were not very capable, and so their setup screens had to be viewed in Portrait mode, before the app would recognize that it needed to be in Landscape mode, based on the screen orientation. This has happened with other apps. So I deferred my decision until I made it through the setup screens — but no, the app simply runs in portrait mode only. Sorry, folks, but our mobile devices are designed to be operated in both Portrait and Landscape modes, so please get your act together and support both modes. In the meantime, I guess MS NOW loses me as a user.

reviews.title: App WAS great but is now broken
reviews.text: The app seems to be stuck in, what I can only assume is, “mobile” mode, displaying on my iPad Pro as a thin, tall window—clearly a “Portrait mode”—while the device is in “Landscape”, shaped to suit a cell phone screen shape, no matter what I do. “Full screen” simply fits within that portrait shape and does not expand to the size and aspect ratio of my actual screen. I’m also seeing instances of the image refusing to match my screen’s rotation, insisting on remaining in profile mode when I’m viewing/reading in landscape. All of this functionality was there LAST week, and then suddenly, along with the rebrand, it’s just bugs bugs bugs at every turn. Guys, this is rudimentary stuff here. Please work it out and get an update up on the App Store. Please.
